_comment: Tier-2 for skfem poisson#: two empirical catalog-drift findings in skfem 12.0.1: (a) get_dofs('left') raises ValueError 'Boundary \'left\' not found' on a freshly constructed mesh — m.with_boundaries({'left': filter}) is required to register the name; (b) to_meshio is NOT removed in v12+, it lives at skfem.io.meshio.to_meshio (just removed from top-level skfem namespace). The catalog text 'For v12+: to_meshio removed — use meshio.Mesh() directly' is misleading. Verified empirically 2026-06-01 (skfem 12.0.1). MUTATION CONTROL (re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 registers the 'left' name before the probe (probe_mesh = m.with_boundaries({'left': filter}) instead of the fresh m) -- the documented fix, applied at the mesh the failing get_dofs queries. Re-verified by execution 2026-08-06 on skfem 12.0.1: the unmutated run matches all 7 expect_in_output strings; T2_MUTATE=1 makes get_dofs('left') resolve instead of raising, which removes 'get_dofs_left_unregistered_raise=True' (and, via the script's own early return, 'left_dof_count=5', 'all_boundary_dof_count=16', 'top_level_to_meshio=False', 'submodule_to_meshio=True', 'meshio_cell_type=quad') and raises the forbidden 'ERROR', so the fixture goes red. Re-run: T2_MUTATE=1 python source.py
